profile.headline: Senior Embedded Systems Engineer | Safety-Critical & Real-Time Systems — Satellites, Avionics, Quantum Control | C/C++/Rust
profile.summary:
13+ years making sure the software that can't be allowed to fail, doesn't — owning systems end-to-end, from architecture down to the hardware itself, across GPS III satellites, DO-178 certified avionics, and now quantum computing control electronics.

At IonQ, I'm the sole owner of an OpenTelemetry observability framework instrumenting 10 quantum control systems — built it from scratch with two teammates who've since moved on, and now drive every new feature, test, and fix myself.

That ownership model is the throughline of my career: real-time OS internals (VxWorks, Green Hills Integrity-178, ARINC 653 time/space partitioning), register/DMA-level device control, and the low-level protocols that let software actually talk to hardware — ARINC 429/653, CAN, SCPI, serial/TTY consoles, dual-ported memory boundaries, A/B U-Boot OTA update stacks. I've shipped Flight Control Computer software under DO-178, built the mission control software that keeps a LEO satellite's radio systems alive and its state machine sane, and written the daemons and control panels that drive satellite lab test equipment.

It's not all bare metal. Earlier, I spent three years at Goldman Sachs inside their proprietary SLANG/SecDb environment, where I designed a self-service reporting system — its own auth integration, flexible config, and a REST API fronting a React SPA — that eliminated an engineering bottleneck the firm had lived with for years. That range, hardware registers to full-stack systems design, is what I bring to a team.

Outside of paid work, I keep sharpening the fundamentals: a GAS-compatible assembler, an ISA register-level virtual machine, an ELF binary format parser, and a software-rendered OpenGL clone, built because I'd rather understand a system from the metal up than take it on faith.

Open to conversations about Senior/Staff embedded systems and systems architecture roles.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - Avionics
positions.description: I am the subject matter expert for the low level avionics of the Merlin Murray Pilot. I spend my days working with passion and boundless energy, and the most talented engineers in the world, to turn the dream of autonomous aviation into reality. I write some of the world's foremost cutting edge avionics software in the c language with the goal of realizing the future of aviation and the advancement of the state of the art for mankind.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Flight Management System project, written in C++, VxWorks, ARINC 653.

My responsibilities include building and testing new software features compliaint with DOJ-178C and based on systems and software requirements. I also worked on Integrating the software with the deployed hardware environment. I was the primary member of the team who spent time finding, diagnosing and troubleshooting issues on the integrated platform. I was required to work with systems requirements to develop and write software requirements and design safety critical software.

positions.title: Software Engineering Specialist
positions.description:
GPS IIIF Satellite
I was in charge of maintaining and enhancing the build pipeline used for the development of the GPSIII test software stack. My duties required me to liaise with the software development team to educate them on its use. I also had to interact with the software team to gather feedback on how the pipeline can be improved to enhance the automation within our development process.

positions.title: Software Engineering Specialist
positions.description:
GPS OCX
I used Python to verify space vehicle configuration uploads.  This required me to compare the generated configuration information against the requests to check that the data is accurate, formatted properly and correct.

positions.title: Software Engineering Specialist
positions.description:
Harris Business Excellence (HBX)
I have been consulting on efforts to introduce DevOps and current software development best practices on Harris software projects. I have provided support on the use of Jenkins for automated software builds and packaging. I have implemented the use of NuGet packaging and the storing of those packages in a binary artifact repository like Sonatype Nexus so that they are easily reusable as well

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
GPS IIIA Satellite 
My responsibilities included implementing software features, maintaining documentation, and working with my teammates on design decisions, as part of the project I have used IBM Rational ClearCase, Doors and ClearQuest.  The software development that I have participated in on this project has been in C# and C++ in support of ground testing equipment for the space vehicles.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Owner and operator

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Foreign Exchange Trading Technology
Supporting internal and external end users by investigating production system issues and general Tech support issues. Production system risk management and mitigation. Oversee the up time of the production environment. Develop and deploy system and tool enhancements. Design and build new features and new systems for Foreign Exchange trading and sales personnel.

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description:
Orion Spacecraft Software Testing
Manual/Automated testing for the Orion Multi-Purpose Crew Vehicle (Orion Spacecraft). Used LDRA to Unit Test C/C++ code modules. Required analyzing the source and building a test plan for each module.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Application Virtualization Testing
Developed automated tests to cover historically manually tested modules. Wrote a WCF service and updated an SSRS report to allow links embedded in the SSRS to rerun failed automated tests. Outlined and oversaw the manual testing of a config maintenance/generation tool to allow end users to more easily setup application virtualization environments.
